summary: A user reported that multiple Swype crypto debit cards purchased through CoinGate stopped working while balances remained on the cards. Support attributed the disruption to an issuing bank outage with no estimated resolution while the user reported that cards continued to be offered for sale.
user_mistake: continued holding funds across multiple third party crypto debit cards
prevention: Keep only spending amounts on crypto debit card services / Stop purchasing or funding cards when transaction and redemption services are disrupted
